## Requirements (from the contract)

1. `policy/src/policy/labels.py` — the one derivation: `label`, `descriptor`,
   `label_basis ∈ {source_name, source_title, key_name, slug_name, derived,
   fallback}` (+ `label_source_id`), `url_key`, `slug`, `hash`, per K2 §3.2.
   person: none — no page, node, label or slug.
2. Deterministic disambiguation within (kind, release): `· {place}` → `· {source}`
   → `#{hash4}`; pure function; no two public entities of a kind share a full
   display label.
3. Slug + hash primitives — `name-slug` per K11 §3 (ASCII-fold, `[a-z0-9]+`
   tokens, no scheme prefixes, `-<K4 display slug of the state>` when placed, cut
   at 56 chars on a token boundary); `hash` = Crockford base32 of
   sha256(canonical UUID text), 7 chars, extended on collision in the slug
   registry, frozen once issued; hash authoritative, slug cosmetic.
4. Part VIII person-name screen over every label input incl. literal parties;
   no label from coordinates finer than the published precision; no private
   registrant street address; handle-like source ids never appear.
5. A-10/ADR-159: registry-matched (allow-dispositioned) organisations labelled;
   every other organisation typed "not yet reviewed" (`label_state`, never bare
   suppression); non-organisation labels ship; withheld entity → no label/node/slug.
6. `sig.entity-label/1` — `labels/<compartment>.jsonl` rows
   `{entity_id, sig_id, kind, url_type, label, descriptor, label_basis,
   label_source_id, place_jkey, slug, hash, url, disambiguator, component_id,
   part8: pass|fallback}` per compartment from the export's one snapshot.
7. Call-site rewires: exporter network label lookup + `entity_labels`, shaping
   site-label path, release-page record builder ("Unnamed deployment" retired),
   API label path.
8. Tests: §3.2 per-kind derivations; disambiguation determinism; person-screen
   over literal parties; withheld-entity no-label; hash collision extension;
   label_basis always populated; API/exporter agreement.
9. Requirement stamps in PR body (UXR-17 recorded as draft id; ADR-159,
   SIG-PUB-008, K2 §3 L-1…L-7, SIG-UI-D20–D25 drafts, SIG-IDENT-031/032 context).
